items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 59:1
items.html: The GAR of Beriah were diminished very much relative to the SAG of Atzilut, because they passed through the screen and the concluding Parsa of Atzilut, which separated completely the illumination of Hochma from them. See answers 50 and 52. (Item 209).
